verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Drata has a Personnel API (list, search, get) and a general claim that it monitors personnel. A community comment adds that people in the corporate directory show up as noncompliant in the dashboard. Nothing documents HR-synced onboarding or offboarding checklists, training-completion tracking for new hires, or proof that leavers lost access. Personnel records and directory-based compliance status are adjacent features, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access
